summary: CEA Industries Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a Consulting Agreement with W4 LLC to provide Alex Odagiu as Interim President, effective July 20, 2026. Odagiu was previously appointed Interim President on June 23, 2026. The agreement pays W4 LLC a monthly fee of $25,000 for 32 hours/week of Odagiu's services. The term continues until a new CEO is appointed; termination before that is for cause only. This represents an interim leadership structure following the departure of prior management. While the appointment is meant to be temporary, the filing does not indicate a forced or abrupt departure; the event is a routine interim management arrangement. Thus, it is classified as Management Changes with medium confidence.
